summary: Iter-31 Landing.jsx refactor regression sweep — frontend-only. Landing.jsx is now a 92-line composer importing 14 modular components from /components/landing/. All 21 acceptance items verified PASS at desktop 1440 and mobile 390. Every required data-testid (26 total: landing-page, header-logo-link, top-login-button, hero-google-login-button, hero-retail-link, hero-tripillar, hero-tripillar-01..03, hero-ecosystem-section, hero-eco-01..05, exp-centre-tab, dws-summary, cta-whatsapp-link, bottom-cta-button, footer-portal-link, footer-retail-link, footer-terms-link, footer-privacy-link, guardian-bot-trigger, theme-toggle, hero-watermark) is present and visible. No regressions detected.

issues: The shortened tagline 'Automotive Intelligence Co.' (rendered correctly via md:hidden) gets visually clipped by overflow-hidden because nav buttons (search icon + theme toggle + Sign-in pill) consume ~190px of the 390px width. Visible text reads 'AUTOMOTIVE INTELLIGE...'. Pre-existing issue, not caused by refactor. Possible mitigation: drop tracking from 0.22em to 0.18em or use `flex-1 min-w-0` on text container with smaller font.

critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: Landing.jsx is now 92 lines (well under 700 limit). State (stats, news) stays in Landing and ticker is built locally then passed to LiveTickerStrip — clean prop drilling.
onLogin handler is correctly lifted to Landing and passed to StickyHeader, HeroSection, BottomCTASection, LandingFooter — single source of truth preserved.

Console shows 401 from /api/public/* or /api/auth/me on initial load for unauthenticated users — expected behavior, not a bug. Consider silencing the axios catch with a console.debug to avoid red console noise.

watermark uses fixed positioning with z-[1] inside the landing-page wrapper (z above grain-overlay) — make sure interactive elements above remain reachable. Verified pointer-events: none in classes — OK.

Mr Genius chat panel: textarea has data-testid='guardian-input' but the submit/send button could not be located by a stable testid in the panel — recommend adding data-testid='guardian-send' for future reliable testing (input+Enter works, but button click path is untested).
test_credentials: n/a — public landing page, no auth flows tested
